description:
Part science nerds, part tech enthusiasts, part creative and chaotic.

We believe innovation doesn’t always require extraordinary resources—sometimes, all it takes is an unconventional perspective, a little ingenuity, and the courage to experiment with what we already have.

Inspired by science, technology, and shared love for exploring the unconventional, we aim to turn ideas into practical innovations that make a difference.

The next big breakthrough comes from thinking OUTTA the box.
